_about: A retrieval hit = any top-k chunk whose text contains ANY anchor (case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed). Anchors are text, not chunk ids, so the set survives chunk-size changes. answerable=false means the corpus has no answer; those are scored separately. parts=true means the anchors are different pieces of ONE answer (not alternatives); the harness then also reports how many of those pieces were found in the top-k. | v2: P1,P3,P4,P5,P8 rewritten by the project owner (assistant's originals kept in 'original_question_assistant_written' and in golden_set_v1.json); U4-U7 and Y8-Y12 written by the owner; 'author':'owner' marks them.
